verdict.rationale: Restricting private sub-teams to specific members is a fair permissions question for a work-management tool like Jira, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents private teams, team-level membership restrictions or permission schemes. 'Global and project-level configuration' and 'SAML & SSO' are adjacent configuration and authentication features, not restricted sub-teams.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create private sub-teams restricted to specific members
